description: Transport-neutral domain contract for evidence-aware temporal network analysis, branch replay, forecast assessment, and reviewed profile learning.

compatibility.policy: Independent additive minor-version snapshot; 0.1.0 records retain their original meaning and require explicit migration before being treated as 0.2.0.
compatibility.migration_rule: A migrated record receives a new identity, exact target version, migration processor identity, source-record reference, and validation result; the source record is never rewritten.

Playground.meaning: Reusable bounded analytical world that may contain multiple Episodes.

Node.meaning: Distinguishable modeled element; identity does not imply personhood or agency.

Relation.meaning: Typed structural condition; it is not a Flow or proven cause by default.

Flow.meaning: Typed movement, exchange, propagation, or rate over Nodes or Relations.

State.meaning: Value believed to hold over an interval, not a complete account of reality.

Event.meaning: Represented occurrence situated in time; extraction alone does not make it certain.

Mechanism.meaning: Evidence-bound rule or hypothesis about how conditions may produce a Transition.

Transition.meaning: Modeled change between Positions; an Action is only one possible cause.

Position.meaning: Reproducible question-bounded projection of relevant modeled State at a frozen evidence and profile cutoff.

Timeline.meaning: Time-indexed or partially ordered view of Events and State changes.

Perspective.meaning: Declared observational or analytical vantage; it cannot rewrite history.

Evaluation.meaning: Profile-bound multi-party vector assessment with inspectable objectives, weights, assumptions, and unknowns.

Action.meaning: Optional intentional intervention where a profile declares agency and control.

Trajectory.meaning: Realized, reconstructed, or simulated succession of Positions and Transitions.

EvidenceItem.rule: Source evidence remains immutable and is never created from prediction text.

Claim.rule: Competing or superseding Claims append; accepted revision never edits the earlier Claim.

ReviewDecision.rule: Only an attributable review decision may adopt a staged Claim revision into canonical model history.

Assertion.rule: Use Claim as the canonical neutral name; Assertion remains a strategy/game-record consumer alias.

Utterance.rule: Words, inferred intent, communication Event, and modeled effect remain distinct.

StrategyStep.rule: A step is a traceable transition view; it never turns an Utterance or proposed Action into an observed outcome.

ProfileSnapshot.rule: A historical Position or forecast retains the exact profile Claims visible at its cutoff.

ContextSnapshot.rule: Replay uses this frozen context and cannot import later or sibling-branch material.

Variation.rule: Purpose is fixed at creation and independent from any later Forecast Assessment.

ObservationCoverage.rule: Missing evidence is not adequate coverage and cannot prove non-occurrence.

ForecastAssessment.rule: Assessment is append-only, forecast-only, and many-to-many; it never rewrites either forecast or actual history.

ActualForecastOutcome.rule: An actual Event may link to several assessments or remain an unmatched surprise relative to the declared eligible forecast set.

ProfileClaimRevisionProposal.rule: Alternative explanations coexist; only reviewed adoption can make a new Claim visible to later Positions.

MethodRun.rule: Method output remains attributable derived material and cannot mutate evidence.

AnalysisRun.rule: Analysis output is a proposal in the knowledge/model or possibility plane, never a direct canonical writer.

SearchRun.rule: Branching is variable and bounded by explicit resources; only materialized Positions require Evaluation.

CacheRecord.rule: Reuse requires exact identity; changed governing inputs create a distinct record or visible supersession.

CalibrationRecord.rule: Calibration is derived and cannot create, accept, reject, or revise a subject/profile Claim.

modes.reconstructed: Derived from authorized historical evidence at a cutoff.

game_record_view.main_line_rule: Only actual or reconstructed items confirmed by authorized evidence may enter Main Line.
game_record_view.variation_rule: Every Variation declares forecast, counterfactual, or exploratory purpose and remains Position-bound possibility data.
game_record_view.frontier_rule: Frontier is the latest confirmed Position plus unresolved candidates; it excludes hypothetical branch state.
game_record_view.realization_rule: Later actual steps append independently; only forecast Variations receive Forecast Assessments, and unmatched actual Events remain visible.
game_record_view.promotion_rule: Later confirmation appends actual history and trace links; it never rewrites a Variation, forecast, source, or frozen snapshot.
game_record_view.dormant_rule: Dormant means processing is paused, not that the external episode concluded.

learning_boundaries.profile_learning_evidence_rule: Observed reaction evidence may support a proposal; forecast text and forecast error are not subject evidence.
learning_boundaries.calibration_rule: Specific assessable residuals may calibrate provider/model, Method, or Search Policy without writing profile Claims.
learning_boundaries.historical_replay_rule: Later accepted Claims affect only later profile snapshots and Positions; old forecasts replay with their original snapshot.

invariants: Every consequential Claim has provenance, epistemic status, author, valid time, observation time, record time, and revision identity.
A Position is a projection and never replaces Events, Claims, or source evidence.
Actual/reconstructed and hypothetical/predicted Trajectories cannot silently merge.
A Relation is not a Flow; a State is not an Event; an Action is not required for every Transition.
Every Strategy Step links before and after Positions, contextual inputs, Transition, mode, evidence, and branch membership.
Every Variation declares exactly one purpose independently from realization status.
Counterfactual and exploratory Variations are not assessed as failed forecasts.
Forecast Assessment is append-only and cannot rewrite forecast content, probability/rank, actual history, frozen context, or processor identity.
Expired-unobserved requires elapsed horizon and adequate observation coverage; otherwise status is pending or unknown.
A realized Event may match several forecasts; one forecast may match several realized Events.
Profile learning preserves competing explanations and requires review before adoption.
An accepted profile Claim revision appends a new Claim and later profile snapshot without changing earlier snapshots or Positions.
Prediction text and prediction residual are not evidence about a represented Node.
Profile learning and provider/Method/Search calibration use distinct record types and writers.
Every materialized Position has a multi-party vector Evaluation; unexpanded possibilities are not claimed as evaluated Positions.
Cache reuse requires exact frozen identity and never imports later or sibling-branch context.
Profiles may add types and terminology but cannot weaken provenance, uncertainty, time, correction, privacy, or possibility/history separation.
